messages:
Nora S: quick dump from today's onboarding call w/ Aldera. Raw capture for triage — they raised a few blocker-ish items.

Caleb K: paste please. any risk to renewal?

Nora S: Notes: 
- Index visibility lag: after a 20k doc import, search didn't return new docs for ~5 hours. Customer: "we couldn't finish our live demo".
- Re-ranking oddness: same query returns different top results intermittently, suspect model variant routing.
- Per-role quotas: they want fine-grained caps (team-level) and a pre-overage webhook/email.
- Bulk import retries: ~3% of items failed with 504 and weren't auto-retried.

Dina V: Routing suggestion: visibility lag -> infra/serving; re-rank -> product-ml + evals; quotas -> billing + cs; retries -> eng-runtime.

Priya: Agree. Label visibility lag + re-rank as P0 for this account (demo impacted). Quota+retries P2.

Nora S: customer quote: "If this keeps happening our pilot may be paused". Marking account: onboarding_at_risk.

ops-bot: Created CS-5188: Aldera indexing visibility delay (https://redwood.atlassian/CS-5188)
eng-bot: Created CS-5189: Aldera re-rank flakiness (https://redwood.atlassian/CS-5189)

Caleb K: Can we capture minimal repro: upload timestamp, sample query, request ids, and any response traces? I'll collect logs and upload to CS-5188.

Dina V: Infra ask: include KV-cache invalidate events, routing decisions, and backend variant mapping. Suspect delayed cache invalidation or async shard indexing backlog.

Nora S: Upload times from customer: upload_start=2026-05-10T09:07:11Z, ingest_done=2026-05-10T09:07:28Z, observed_missing=09:10-14:30.

Caleb K: quick log excerpt they shared:
```
2026-05-10T09:07:11Z import start job=aldera_20k user=ak_admin
2026-05-10T09:07:28Z ingest complete job=aldera_20k shards=12
2026-05-10T09:07:29Z kv-cache-invalidate queued key=idx/aldera/20k
2026-05-10T09:07:29Z route->variant select variant=v2 delay=50ms
2026-05-10T09:11:03Z 504 upstream timeout id=task_42
2026-05-10T14:30:12Z query id=qry_7 returned=10
```

Priya: For Friday product sync propose scoring: renewal_risk=3, demo_impact=3, eng_effort=2. We'll present CS-5188/CS-5189 with that.

Dina V: I'll assign infra oncall to trace ingest backlog and check shard queue lengths. Also will look at retry policy for bulk imports.

Caleb K: Action items: Caleb -> upload logs & queries to CS-5188 (by EOD); Dina -> infra traces (tomorrow AM); Priya -> prioritization Friday; Nora -> update Aldera playbook and send acknowledgment.

Nora S: sending ack now and will add the risk tag on CS dashboard. Thanks team :pray:
